description: Implicit durable-fact disclosure scenarios. Positive cases: a stable user/project fact surfaces in ordinary conversation with NO memory-instruction wording — the engram skill must fire, write exactly once, and acknowledge in the same turn. Negative cases: transient context, near-miss domains (RAM/cache/db), explicit refusal, secrets, file-op pseudo-triggers — no engram call may occur. Judge anchors: engram operation traces (MCP memory_* call or engram CLI invocation) plus store-side verification; skill-load events are diagnostic only. v2: bilingual seed content (offline keyword retrieval is language-sensitive; seeds carry both zh and en keywords).
